name: The feedback dialog's three body heights and the ≤480 sheet's top edge jumping 91.46px (R1 F9)
outcome: Feedback dialog keeps one body height from the press of 보내기/다시 시도 onward: the rendered body height is read at press time and applied as an inline min-height, actions pinned to the bottom of a pinned body — the −75.45px top-edge drop @1280 and the ≤480 sheet's 91.46px jump become one dialog rect across editing→sending→sent→failed→retry in dev and production build vs HEAD; resting AE=0 at both viewports. 닫기's unmount measured (moves only itself) so the signed 'disappears' ships unchanged; the send button's +53.47px label growth ships no code → Q9 (same decision as Q7). Sends go to vocky, not a Mijual table
